name: customer360__address
      description: Consolidated customer addresses from Marketo and Stripe enriched with standardized country/state names and priority-based ranking
      grain: One row per sourced address per customer360_id (duplicates preserved)
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - staging.stg_customer360__country_codes
      - staging.stg_customer360__state_territory_codes
      business_logic: '- Read pass-through datasets: - marts.customer360__mapping as mapping (provides marketo_lead_id and stripe_customer_id per customer360_id) - staging.stg_customer360__country_codes as country_codes - staging.stg_customer360__state_territory_codes as state_codes - Build Marketo addresses (inner join mapping.marketo_lead_id = int_customer360__marketo.lead_id): - Primary address: include rows where address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "marketo", address_type = "primary", priority = 1; select address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state_code, country_code, postal_code - Billing address: include rows where billing_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "marketo", address_type = "billing", priority = 2; map billing_* fields to output columns - Build Stripe addresses (inner join mapping.stripe_customer_id = int_customer360__stripe.customer_id): - Customer address: include rows where customer_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "stripe", address_type = "customer", priority = 1; map customer_* fields - Shipping address: include rows where shipping_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "stripe", address_type = "shipping", priority = 2; map shipping_* fields - Union all Marketo and Stripe address rows; no de-duplication; only addresses with non-NULL address_line_1 are included. - Enrich with geographic names via left joins: - state: join state_codes on (state_code AND country_code) to derive state_territory; unmatched → NULL - country and country_alt_name: join country_codes on alpha-2 country code; unmatched → NULL - Compute rank: per customer360_id, assign row numbers ordered by priority ascending; within the same priority, order is unspecified and non-deterministic. - Output passes through source text as-is (casing/whitespace preserved); no normalization beyond the joins.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer key from mapping used to group and rank addresses; multiple rows per customer360_id
      - name: source_system
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Origin system literal ('marketo' or 'stripe'); set per source and always non-null
      - name: address_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Address category set per source: Marketo → ''primary'' or ''billing''; Stripe → ''customer'' or ''shipping'''
      - name: address_line_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary address line; rows are included only when this is non-null; text is passed through without trimming or case changes
      - name: address_line_2
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Secondary address line from source; may be null; text is passed through without trimming or case changes
      - name: city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from source; may be null; no transformation
      - name: state_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/province code from source used for state name enrichment; may be null; case preserved
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved state/territory name from stg_customer360__state_territory_codes via (state_code,country_code) match; null if no match
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO alpha-2 country code from source used for joins; may be null; case preserved
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved country name from stg_customer360__country_codes via country_code_alpha_2; null if no match
      - name: country_alt_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Alternative country name from stg_customer360__country_codes; null if no match
      - name: postal_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Postal code from source stored as BIGINT; may be null; numeric-only storage means leading zeros are not preserved
      - name: priority
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Address priority set by source (1 for primary/customer, 2 for billing/shipping); lower number indicates higher priority
      - name: rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Row number per customer360_id ordered by priority ascending; ties within the same priority have arbitrary order

name: int_asana__task_projects
      description: Task-project relationships with aggregated project IDs, names, and sections
      grain: One row per task_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__project_task
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - staging.stg_asana__task_section
      - staging.stg_asana__section
      business_logic: 'Build task-project relationships and aggregates: - Start from staging.stg_asana__project_task (project_task). - Left join staging.stg_asana__project (project) on project_id after casting project_task.project_id to VARCHAR to match project.project_id; retain rows when the project is missing. - Left join staging.stg_asana__task_section (task_section) on task_id after casting both sides to VARCHAR; this can multiply project rows for tasks with multiple sections. - Left join staging.stg_asana__section (section) on section_id after casting task_section.section_id to VARCHAR; set section_name to "(no section)" when missing. - Produce task_projects_base with task_id, project_id, project_name, section_name. - Aggregate by task_id to form the output: - project_ids: concatenate all non-NULL project_id values using ", ", ordered ascending by project_id; duplicates are kept; if there are no non-NULL values the result is NULL; casing and whitespace are preserved. - project_names: concatenate all non-NULL project_name values using ", ", ordered ascending by project_name; duplicates are kept; if there are no non-NULL values the result is NULL; casing and whitespace are preserved. - projects_sections: for each row, create "project_name (section_name)" using "(no section)" when section is missing; exclude rows where project_name is NULL; concatenate using ", ", ordered ascending by project_name; duplicates are kept; if there are no non-NULL pairs the result is NULL; casing and whitespace are preserved. - number_of_projects: count distinct project_id values per task_id; NULL project_id is excluded; duplicates caused by multiple sections do not increase the count. - Output includes only task_ids present in project_task.'
      columns:
      - name: task_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique task identifier; exactly one output row per task_id
      - name: project_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma + space separated project_id values ordered ascending by project_id; duplicates kept; NULL project_id excluded; if none → NULL; casing/whitespace preserved
      - name: project_names
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma + space separated project_name values ordered ascending by project_name; duplicates kept; NULL names excluded; if none → NULL; casing/whitespace preserved
      - name: projects_sections
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma + space separated 'project_name (section_name)' pairs ordered ascending by project_name; section_name uses '(no section)' when missing; pairs with NULL project_name excluded; duplicates kept; if none → NULL; casing/whitespace preserved
      - name: number_of_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project_id per task_id; NULL project_id excluded; duplicates from multiple sections do not increase the count

name: int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      description: Customer profitability metrics, scoring, and recommendations per customer and subsidiary based on converted_amount aggregations; final rows require total_revenue > 0.
      grain: One row per customer_id per subsidiary_id (after filtering to total_revenue > 0)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: 'Build customer_transactions: - Join transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id. - Keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Income, COGS, Expense, or OthExpense. - Derive customer fields from entity_id: customer_id equals entity_id; customer_name as ''Customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id; customer_email as ''customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id plus ''@example.com''. - Set customer_creation_date to the current date minus 365 days and customer_age_days to 365. - Categorize transactions by account_type_name: Income as Revenue; COGS as Cost_of_Sales; Expense and OthExpense as Operating_Expense. Aggregate to customer_metrics at the level of customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_creation_date, customer_age_days, subsidiary_id: - total_revenue: sum of converted_amount for Revenue transactions (signed). - total_cogs: sum of absolute converted_amount for Cost_of_Sales. - allocated_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount for Operating_Expense. - gross_profit: total_revenue minus total_cogs. - net_profit: gross_profit minus allocated_expenses. - transaction_count: distinct count of transaction_id. - active_months: distinct count of calendar months from accounting_period_ending. - first_transaction_date and last_transaction_date: earliest and latest accounting_period_ending. - average_order_value: total_revenue divided by transaction_count; use 0 when transaction_count is 0. Enrich in customer_segmentation: - gross_margin_pct: gross_profit divided by total_revenue; use 0 when total_revenue is 0. - net_margin_pct: net_profit divided by total_revenue; use 0 when total_revenue is 0. - customer_lifetime_months: months between first and last transaction, inclusive; use 1 when either date is missing. - customer_maturity from customer_age_days: under 90 days is New Customer; under 365 is Growing Relationship; under 1095 is Established Customer; otherwise Long-term Customer. - activity_status from days since last_transaction_date at run time: 30 or fewer is Highly Active; 31–90 is Active; 91–180 is At Risk; over 180 is Inactive. - analysis_date equals the current date. Score in customer_value_scoring: - revenue_score: 5 for total_revenue at or above the 80th percentile; 4 at or above the 60th; 3 at or above the 40th; 2 at or above the 20th; otherwise 1. Percentiles are computed over all rows in customer_segmentation (before the final filter). - frequency_score: 5 for 20 or more transactions; 4 for 10–19; 3 for 5–9; 2 for 2–4; otherwise 1. - margin_score: 5 for net_margin_pct at or above 0.30; 4 at or above 0.20; 3 at or above 0.10; 2 at or above 0.05; 1 for greater than 0; otherwise 0. Final computations and filter: - total_customer_score equals revenue_score plus frequency_score plus margin_score. - customer_segment: Champion for scores 12 or higher; Loyal for 9–11; Potential for 6–8; At Risk for 3–5; Lost for below 3. - predicted_clv: if customer_lifetime_months and active_months are both greater than 0, multiply net_profit per month by the larger of 12 months and 1.2 times customer_lifetime_months; otherwise use net_profit. - investment_recommendation: High Investment when net_margin_pct is at least 0.20 and activity_status is Highly Active or Active; Medium Investment when net_margin_pct is at least 0.10 and total_revenue exceeds the average total_revenue across customer_segmentation; Low Investment when net_margin_pct is greater than 0; otherwise Review Required. - Keep rows where customer_id is present and total_revenue is greater than 0. - customer_profitability_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by customer_id, an underscore, and subsidiary_id; it is null if either component is null.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_profitability_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of customer_id + '_' + subsidiary_id; null when either component is null; unique per (customer_id, subsidiary_id).
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from transaction lines; final rows require non-null.
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic name: ''Customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id.'
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic email: ''customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id and ''@example.com''.'
      - name: customer_creation_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Current date minus 365 days at run time for all rows.
      - name: customer_age_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 365 representing days since customer_creation_date.
      - name: customer_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bucket from customer_age_days: New (<90), Growing (<365), Established (<1095), Long-term (otherwise).'
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary from transaction details; may be null; part of the row grain and ID hash.
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Signed sum of converted_amount for Revenue transactions; final rows require > 0.
      - name: total_cogs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Cost_of_Sales; non-negative.
      - name: allocated_expenses
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Operating_Expense; non-negative.
      - name: gross_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_revenue minus total_cogs; may be negative.
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: gross_profit minus allocated_expenses; may be negative.
      - name: gross_margin_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: gross_profit divided by total_revenue when total_revenue > 0, else 0; ratio not a formatted percent.
      - name: net_margin_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: net_profit divided by total_revenue when total_revenue > 0, else 0; ratio not a formatted percent.
      - name: transaction_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of transaction_id across included categories; at least 1 in final rows.
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of calendar months present in accounting_period_ending; at least 1.
      - name: customer_lifetime_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Inclusive months between first and last transaction; 1 when either date is missing.
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest accounting_period_ending for the customer and subsidiary.
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending for the customer and subsidiary.
      - name: average_order_value

name: workday__organization_overview
      description: Executive-ready overview of each active organization with headcount, roles, tenure, mobility, risk, performance, diversity, compensation tiers, promotions, derived scores, recommendations, and data quality
      grain: One row per active organization_id and source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_workday__organization (filtered to is_inactive = false)
      - staging.stg_workday__worker_position_organization
      - staging.stg_workday__organization_role_worker
      - staging.stg_workday__organization_role
      - mart.workday__employee_overview (filtered to organization_id != 'Unknown')
      business_logic: '1) Filter organizations to active only and expose attributes and effective_start as the creation date. 2) Build worker–organization–role relationships by left joining worker positions to role-worker and role master on matching worker, role, source_relation, and organization_id. For each assignment: - assignment_status: ''Active Assignment'' if end date is null, else ''Former Assignment''. - assignment_duration_days: days between start and end; if end is null, days between start and current_date. - carry organization_role_id and organization_role_code from the role join. 3) Aggregate organization_employee_stats by (organization_id, source_relation): - total_employees_ever: distinct workers across all assignments. - current_active_employees: distinct workers with Active Assignment. - former_employees: distinct workers with Former Assignment. - total_positions_in_org: distinct positions across all assignments. - active_positions_count: distinct positions with Active Assignment. - new_assignments_last_year: distinct workers with start date in the last year relative to current_date. - departures_last_year: distinct workers with a non-null end date in the last year. - avg_current_tenure_days: average assignment_duration_days for Active Assignments. - avg_former_tenure_days: average assignment_duration_days for Former Assignments. - unique_organization_roles: distinct organization_role_id. - management_role_employees / director_role_employees / lead_role_employees: distinct workers where role code contains ''Manager'' / ''Director'' / ''Lead''. - last_new_assignment_date: most recent start date; last_departure_date: most recent end date. 4) Aggregate organization_performance_metrics from mart.workday__employee_overview by (organization_id, source_relation), excluding organization_id = ''Unknown'': - Averages over currently employed workers only: overall_employee_score and career_development_score rounded to 2 decimals; retention_stability_score rounded to 2 decimals; age rounded to 1 decimal. - Employee value segments: distinct workers by segment (''High Value - High Retention'', ''High Value - Flight Risk'', ''Stable - Development Needed'', ''Development Required''); no employment filter. - Risk distribution: distinct workers by employee_risk_level (High/Medium/Low); no employment filter. - Maturity segments: distinct employed workers where maturity contains ''New Hire'' / ''Junior'' / ''Experienced'' / ''Senior'' / ''Veteran''. - Diversity: distinct ethnicity_codes among employed; military_veterans_count is distinct employed workers flagged for military service. - Compensation tiers: distinct employed workers by compensation_tier (Entry/Mid/Senior/Executive Level). - Promotions among employed: total_promotions summed; high_achievers_count is distinct workers with total_promotions ≥ 2; fast_track_employees_count is distinct workers with fast_promotions > 0. 5) Derive organization attributes per active organization: - organization_created_date from effective_start. - organization_age_days as days from creation to current_date; organization_age_years is that divided by 365, rounded to 2 decimals. - organization_maturity_level by age_days: <1 year New; 1–3 years Young; 3–10 years Mature; 10+ years Legacy. - organizational_level from organization_type: Company/Division/Department/Team mapped to corresponding Level; others to Other Level. - access_level from visibility: Public→Open Access, Private→Restricted Access, others Unknown Access. 6) Final metrics and rules (rates rounded to 2 decimals; missing metrics default to 0 unless noted): - position_fill_rate (%) = current_active_employees ÷ total_positions × 100 when total_positions > 0, else 0. - annual_turnover_rate (%) = departures_last_year ÷ current_active_employees × 100 when current_active_employees > 0, else 0. - avg_current_tenure_years and avg_former_tenure_years = respective average tenure days ÷ 365, rounded to 2; if no data, treated as 0. - management_ratio (%) = (management_role_employees + director_role_employees) ÷ current_active_employees × 100 when current_active_employees > 0, else 0. - high_risk_employee_percentage (%) = high_risk_employees ÷ current_active_employees × 100 when current_active_employees > 0, else 0. - organization_health_score (0–100) = sum of: performance (cap at 30% of average performance), turnover (25/20/15/10/5 by thresholds using annual_turnover_rate and zero departures case), development (cap at 20% of average career development), efficiency (15/12/9/6 by position_fill_rate thresholds), and risk (10/7/4/2 by high_risk_employee_percentage thresholds); final score rounded to 2 decimals. - performance_category uses a weighted composite with thresholds: Excellent if composite ≥ 80; else Good if ≥ 60; else Average if ≥ 40; otherwise Needs Improvement (weights and constants follow the detailed rules above). - organization_size_category by current_active_employees: 0 Empty; ≤5 Micro; ≤15 Small; ≤50 Medium; ≤200 Large; else Enterprise. - last_activity_date is the most recent assignment start; if none, use organization_created_date. - last_departure_date is the most recent assignment end; if none, use 1900-01-01. - management_recommendation (first match): if no active employees then review necessity; else if turnover > 30% then focus on retention; else if high-risk % > 25% then address risk; else if fill rate < 70% then improve staffing; else if average performance < 50 then enhance performance management; else if management_ratio > 40% then optimize structure; else maintain excellence. - data_quality_flag precedence: missing or blank organization name → ERROR; active employees exceed positions by more than 10 → WARNING; turnover rate > 100% → WARNING; negative age days → ERROR; otherwise VALID. - analysis_timestamp is the query execution timestamp. 7) Join logic: left join employee stats and performance metrics to active organizations on (organization_id, source_relation); missing measures default to 0. The final ordering is for presentation only and does not affect grain.'
      columns:
      - name: organization_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization identifier; join key to stats and metrics; one output row per active (organization_id, source_relation)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation

        description: Source system code carried from staging and used in all joins

      - name: organization_name

      - name: organizational_level

      - name: total_employees_ever

      - name: current_active_employees

name: apple_store__subscription_report
      description: Daily subscription KPIs per product and territory; joins summary and events to the reporting grain and enriches with country names/regions; missing measures are zero-filled.
      grain: One row per date_day × vendor_number × app_apple_id × subscription_name × territory_short × state × source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_report
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_summary
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_events
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_report as the driver; output one row per key: date_day, vendor_number, app_apple_id, subscription_name, country (as territory_short), state, source_relation. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_summary on vendor_number, app_apple_id, date_day, subscription_name, country, state, and source_relation to bring active_* measures. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_events on the same keys to bring event_* measures. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes on country_code_alpha_2 = reporting country; set territory_long to alternative country name when available, otherwise the standard country name; set region and sub_region from the match. - Pass through app_name and source_relation from the reporting grain; set territory_short from the reporting country and state from the reporting state. - Null handling: replace missing active_* and event_* measures with 0; geography fields from country_codes are null when no country match; other string fields are passed through unchanged. - No aggregation, sorting, or filtering is applied; row multiplicity follows the joins and assumes uniqueness of joined sources on the stated keys.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Day timestamp from the reporting grain; used in joins; no timezone conversion.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: vendor_number
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Vendor identifier from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_apple_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Application Apple ID from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name passed through from the reporting grain.
      - name: subscription_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subscription product name from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: territory_long
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Country name from country_codes: use alternative name when available, otherwise the standard country name; null if no country match.'
      - name: territory_short
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Two-letter ISO alpha-2 country code from the reporting grain; preserved as stored.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/province code from the reporting grain; may be null.
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country_codes for the matched country; null if not found.
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country_codes for the matched country; null if not found.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
      - name: active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on introductory free trials from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on pay-as-you-go introductory offers from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on pay-up-front introductory offers from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_standard_price_subscriptions

      - name: event_renew

        description: Renewal event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.

name: int_xero__invoice_line_items_enriched
      description: Enriched Xero invoice line items with account, invoice/contact, and active tracking attributes; includes effective tax rate (percent, 2 decimals)
      grain: One row per line_item_id (rows with NULL line_item_id or NULL invoice_id are excluded)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item
      - staging.stg_xero__invoice
      - staging.stg_xero__account
      - staging.stg_xero__contact
      - staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item_has_tracking_category
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category_option
      - staging.stg_xero__tracking_category_has_option
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item selecting: line_item_id, invoice_id, account_code, description, quantity, unit_amount, line_amount, tax_amount, tax_type, discount_rate, processed_at. - Exclude rows where line_item_id or invoice_id is NULL. - Join invoice header by invoice_id to add contact_id (left join; if no match, contact_id is NULL). - Join contacts by contact_id to add contact_name (left join; if no match, contact_name is NULL). - Join accounts by account_code after converting the line item account_code to text to match the account table; add account_name, account_type, account_class (left join; if no match, these are NULL). The output account_code remains the original numeric value from the line item. - Build tracking attributes: - Take invoice_id, line_item_id, tracking_option, tracking_category_id from staging.stg_xero__invoice_line_item_has_tracking_category. - Construct the set of active category/option pairs by linking categories to options through their relationship and keeping only options marked active. - Keep only tracking pairs whose option name exactly matches an active option for that category. - For each (invoice_id, line_item_id), pivot to columns for Region, Department, Project, Location, Class, Customer, and any category whose name contains "Cost Center". If multiple active options exist for the same category on a line, choose the lexicographically greatest non-null option name; if none, leave NULL. - Compute effective_tax_rate as: tax_amount divided by (line_amount minus tax_amount), multiplied by 100, then rounded to 2 decimals. If the denominator is zero or any input is null, the result is null. - All numeric values (quantity, unit_amount, line_amount, tax_amount, discount_rate) and processed_at are passed through without rescaling; processed_at retains its timezone.'
      columns:
      - name: line_item_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique identifier for the invoice line item; exactly one output row per value
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: invoice_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Invoice identifier from the line item; rows with NULL are excluded
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Numeric account code from the line item; joined to accounts by converting to text; output remains numeric
        tests: []
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the accounts table via left join; NULL if no match
        tests: []
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type from the accounts table via left join; NULL if no match
        tests: []
      - name: account_class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High-level account classification from the accounts table via left join; NULL if no match
        tests: []
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line item description from staging
        tests: []
      - name: quantity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Quantity from the line item; pass-through with no rounding or rescaling
        tests: []
      - name: unit_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unit amount from the line item; pass-through with no rescaling
        tests: []
      - name: line_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Extended line amount from the line item; used with tax_amount to compute effective_tax_rate
        tests: []
      - name: tax_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Tax amount for the line item; pass-through
        tests: []
      - name: effective_tax_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Tax amount divided by (line amount minus tax amount) times 100, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if denominator is zero or inputs are NULL
        tests: []
      - name: tax_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tax type code from the line item; pass-through
        tests: []
      - name: discount_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Discount rate from the line item; pass-through without normalization
        tests: []
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact identifier from the invoice header via left join; NULL if not found
        tests: []
      - name: contact_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact name from the contacts table via left join on contact_id; NULL if no match
        tests: []
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tracking option for category 'Region' (active options only); if multiple, the lexicographically greatest option is chosen; NULL if none
        tests: []
      - name: department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tracking option for category 'Department' (active options only); if multiple, the lexicographically greatest option is chosen; NULL if none
        tests: []
      - name: project
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tracking option for category 'Project' (active options only); if multiple, the lexicographically greatest option is chosen; NULL if none
        tests: []
      - name: location

        tests: []
      - name: class

        tests: []
      - name: customer
